Sign in OVERVIEW THE 10 TIPS PULSE DIRECTORY GET FOUND BUSINESSES EVENTS SUPPORT BECOME A PARTNER GET ACCESS BECOME A PARTNER Vegans Explore Nonprofit Partners THE PARTNERSHIP TELL US ABOUT YOU The organization is the partner. Nonprofit Partners join by invitation; tell us about your organization and our team will be in touch. 1 Your own link A short link for your organization, separate from anyone's personal one. Visits and sign-ups through it count for the organization. 2 Points for our services Points your organization holds, set when you are invited, toward promoting your events, a feature or a social push. Members can give you more. 3 A marketing kit Ready-to-post messages, a website button and banner, and an email blurb, all carrying your link. 4 A badge and your own Guide The Nonprofit Partner badge on your page and Directory card, and a Guide for your lead with your numbers. 5 Your lead is on us The person who runs the partnership gets a complimentary Founding Membership. If the lead changes, everything stays with the organization.
